value.rationale: Finite logical frame semantics needs concrete classification of relations compatible with order; crossing two independent ordered carriers is a natural correspondence problem with four structural widths, rather than the already known one-top self-relation case. The exact all-size four-parameter count, plus structural partition, provides genuinely new numbers for mixed-width and double-wide cases (e.g. 1867 for 2+2 to 2+2), enabling exact finite search-space estimates and testing semantics across different carriers. This is not merely a one-value computation or trivial substitution into the one-top count.
